description_summary: This data product provides 15-day forecasts from the station-trained temperature and dew point head, evaluated on a global grid. These fields are distinct from the gridded fields in the 0.1 degree products. Google's precomputed ensemble mean and percentiles are selected along the `statistic` dimension. The spatial dimensions `y` and `x` hold latitude and 0-360 degree longitude.
description_details:
### Source

This data product is built from Google's [WeatherNext 3 statistics archive](https://developers.google.com/weathernext/guides/gcs). Google supplies the mean and the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentiles of its ensemble; these are exposed as `mean`, `p10`, `p25`, `p50`, `p75` and `p90` on the `statistic` dimension. Individual ensemble members are not included. Google's [attributions and acknowledgements](https://storage.googleapis.com/weathernext-public/weathernext-3-attributions-acknowledgements.pdf) list third-party materials whose terms may also apply.

**Modifications.** dynamical.org restructures the source into an Icechunk virtual data product with dynamical.org's variable and dimension names and converts units as data is read. Temperatures are converted from kelvin to degrees Celsius.

### Data availability

This data product starts with the 2026-01-01T00 UTC initialization and is updated four times a day. Forecasts include steps whose valid time is in the future. Forecasts are initialized at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC. Recent initializations may be incomplete while source data arrives; unpublished steps read as NaN.

### Chunks

This dataset is stored in [Zarr](https://zarr.dev/) format, which splits each variable into a grid of **chunks** — the smallest unit read from storage. When possible, aligning your reads with this dataset's chunk grid can significantly improve data access speed.

The element count and coordinate span of this dataset:

| dimension | chunk |
|---|---|
| init_time | 1 (6 hours) |
| statistic | 1 |
| lead_time | 1 (1 hour) |
| y | 3601 (180.05°) |
| x | 7200 (360°) |
| **uncompressed** | 98.9 MiB |

### Validation report

Review the [validation report](https://dynamical.org/catalog/google-weathernext3-forecast-15-day-0-05-degree-virtual/validation/) for variable availability, missing data, known quirks, fill values, value distributions, and sample plots.
description_model: WeatherNext 3 is Google's global probabilistic weather forecasting model. It combines atmospheric analyses with satellite observations and produces forecasts trained against gridded fields and weather station observations.

variants.label: dynamical-catalog
variants.code:
import dynamical_catalog  # dynamical-catalog>=1.0.0

ds = dynamical_catalog.open("google-weathernext3-forecast-15-day-0-05-degree-virtual", chunks=None)
ds["temperature_2m"].sel(init_time="2026-07-01T00", lead_time="24h", statistic="mean", y=slice(25, 55), x=slice(230, 300))

variants.label: pystac
variants.code:
import icechunk
import pystac
import xarray as xr

catalog = pystac.Catalog.from_file("https://stac-staging.dynamical.org/catalog.json")
collection = catalog.get_child("google-weathernext3-forecast-15-day-0-05-degree-virtual")
asset = collection.assets["icechunk-https"]

authorize = icechunk.containers_credentials({"https://wn.dynamical.org/chunks/": icechunk.Credentials.HttpAccess()})
repo = icechunk.Repository.open(
    icechunk.http_storage(asset.href),
    authorize_virtual_chunk_access=authorize,
)
session = repo.readonly_session("main")

ds = xr.open_zarr(session.store, chunks=None)
ds["temperature_2m"].sel(init_time="2026-07-01T00", lead_time="24h", statistic="mean", y=slice(25, 55), x=slice(230, 300))
